skill.displayName: Campus Morning Brief / 校园晨报

version.changelog: Add GitHub contribution guidance, issue templates, pull request template, and README discoverability updates.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed student morning-brief workflow with a local validator/renderer and no evidence of hidden, destructive, or exfiltrating behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe generating a student-friendly campus brief from a profile, current weather/news gathered by the agent, and structured JSON rendered to Markdown/HTML.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill asks the agent to fetch current weather and news and to use profile details, but it also requires source URLs, age-appropriate filtering, no invented private facts, and confirmation before delivery or printing unless a pre-authorized automation exists.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is a standard ClawHub skill install with no third-party Python runtime dependencies or unusual installer behavior shown in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime behavior is proportionate: the script reads one provided JSON file, validates it, creates the chosen output directory, and writes Markdown, HTML, and metadata files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Generated outputs and metadata can contain student profile details, reminders, and source lists, but this is disclosed and the skill tells users to keep credentials, private schedules, delivery identifiers, and generated issues outside the skill directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting your agent research current weather and news and include student profile details in generated local files. Review the output directory, avoid storing sensitive schedules or credentials in the skill directory, and keep delivery or printing gated by explicit authorization unless you have intentionally configured an automation.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The claimed mismatch is downgraded: the executable script only validates and renders prepared JSON, but the SKILL.md and README disclose the broader agent workflow for researching current weather/news before rendering, and the metadata output is explicitly documented.
[suspicious.dynamic_code_execution] expected: The static finding is in a test file using importlib to load the local render_brief.py module for unit tests; it is not hidden runtime behavior of the installed skill.
